§ 02 · The Invitation

The retreat,
in essence.

A five-day immersive retreat in the mountains of Andalusia — where structure meets absolute freedom. Held in the Andalusian mountains, in a temple-like sanctuary nestled in the hills above Marbella, Spain, this retreat is a complete journey back to yourself.

You'll be nourished by extraordinary vegetarian food, held by the beauty of nature, and guided through daily Ashtanga Vinyasa Yoga, breathwork, ecstatic dance, sound meditation, and sacred ceremony — each element woven together to bring you home to the full aliveness that is already yours.

§ 05 · The 'Why'

A bridge between
focus and freedom.

— Patañjali · Yoga Sūtra I·2 —
योगश्चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधः
yogaś-citta-vṛtti-nirodhaḥ
Yoga is the stilling of the fluctuations of the mind.
01 · The Ground

We don't go on retreats just to rest.

What we are really seeking is something deeper — the ability to return to our lives feeling present, focused, and fully inhabiting ourselves.

Without an inner foundation, even joy slips through our fingers.

02 · The Practice

Structure as sacred architecture.

We begin with Ashtanga Vinyasa Yoga — the most sacred architecture for building inner core strength, a strong nervous system, and a clear mind.

From that foundation, we cleanse the vessel through breathwork, liberate the body through ecstatic dance, and through sound meditation, descend into the subconscious — to meet ourselves at depth, with courage and full acceptance.

03 · The Invitation

For those who want to drive their vehicle fully.

Divinely empowered to live this life unlimitedly. Strong and free. Structured and alive. Fully present, even in the dream.

Each modality is a doorway into the next — yoga, breath, dance, sound — woven together so the practice meets you wherever you are.

04 · The Rising

Transformation happens through you.

Every element here — structure, movement, breath, sound, dance — these are the exact elements that brought Julia to receiving her own life fully. Together they weave the four pillars of real transformation: structure, joy, freedom, and truth.

Not a sweet, comfortable version of growth — but a real one. From that truth we rise — back into our highest selves, back into the full voltage of this life.

§ 09 · The Facilitator

Held by
Julia Grant-Scott.

Julia Grant-Scott is a sound and embodiment artist carrying heritage from the vast lands of Central Asia. Originally from Kazakhstan, she often reminds that "the lotus grows from mud" — as life led her through plenty of it. This very ground became the foundation for her own transformation.

Her journey weaves together Ashtanga Vinyasa Yoga, dance, breathwork and sound — each one shaping her relationship with life and deepening her presence. Today, Julia creates immersive spaces for those who are ready to meet themselves fully — through the discipline of the body, the intelligence of the breath, the liberation of movement, and the prayer of sound. Not as separate practices, but as one unified path back to yourself.

She shares sacred sound journeys that are less about performance and more about prayer — spaces where people can reconnect with their higher self and remember their connection with the divine. She will hold space together with multidimensional musician Bart Palyga.

Julia is lovingly called Brahmama, inspired by the Indian concept of Nada Brahma — "Sound is God, and God is Sound." A name that holds both reverence and playfulness, much like the work she offers.

Julia's work is for those who are ready to listen — not just with their ears, but with their whole being.

ॐ · BRAHMAMA ·
§ 10 · Also Holding Space

Joined by two.

Jac Høja
— cellist · sound journeys

Jac Høja is an internationally acclaimed cellist based in Los Angeles. His music moves between the classical and the transcendent — a sound that opens space in the body before a single word is spoken.

On this retreat, Jac will offer live cello concerts and sound journeys inside spaces that carry the memory of the land.

Rae Roots
— ashtanga yoga · roots flow

Rae Roots is an ashtanga yoga teacher and practitioner who will be assisting, and offering Roots Flow. She helps women honour their wisdom through asana and pranayama, and helps them connect with their inner strength, intuition and rhythm.
